name: The Heathen's Brand
label: Quest
description: The Heathen's Brand: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I may have been too hasty in my judgement, adventurer. It seems as if your blind faith in this Light has some value after all.
Give me your brand and I shall amplify its power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do what you must to defeat our enemies, adventurer. Even if it means channeling the Light.
